theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_rn_positive_real_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν μ : Measure X) (B : Set X), MeasurableSet B → SigmaFinite (ν.restrict B) → SigmaFinite μ → μ Bᶜ = 0 → μ ≪ ν → ∃ (M : Set X) (θ : X → ℝ), M ⊆ B ∧ MeasurableSet M ∧ Measurable θ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) ∧ (∀ K : Set X, MeasurableSet K → μ K < ∞ → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) ν) ∧ μ = (ν.restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
